operations.name: Search Listings
operations.description: Find classified ads that match a keyword in one Craigslist city area

fields.description: What to search for: an item, a brand or a model
The Craigslist area to search: the part of its web address before .craigslist.org, e.g. newyork, sfbay or chicago

options.description: The Craigslist section to search, by its code: sss for everything for sale, cta for cars and trucks, apa for apartments and housing, jjj for jobs. Any other Craigslist section code works too.
Lowest price to include, in US dollars. 0 means no minimum.
Highest price to include, in US dollars. 0 means no limit.
The country Craigslist is opened from. Automatic uses the US.
